newsitem.title: CROATIA: Belgian UN soldier killed in Croatian Serb enclave.
newsitem.headline: Belgian UN soldier killed in Croatian Serb enclave.

text.p: A Belgian corporal was killed and two other U.N. officials injured in a shooting incident in the Serb-controlled town of Vukovar in eastern Croatia on Friday, a United Nations spokesman said.

"An investigation was initiated and the U.N. and the Transitional Police Force (TPF) arrested the suspect," Philip Arnold, spokesman for the U.N. Transitional Authority in Eastern Slavonia, told a news conference.
A Jordanian soldier and a civilian officer of the U.N. Transitional Administration (UNTAES) wounded in the shooting were taken to hospital.

The incident happened at 10.30 a.m. (0930 GMT) close to UNTAES headquarters in Vukovar, the biggest town in the Serb-held region of Eastern Slavonia which is due to return to Croatian government rule by mid-June, Arnold said.
"The situation is contained," Arnold quoted the UNTAES military commander, Belgian Major-General Willie Hanset, as saying.
Hanset said the incident has "necessitated initiating control measures" but did not specify what they were. No other details of the incident were immediately available.
